user.description: Choose how you want to authenticate with Aurora+. OAuth is recommended for the best experience.
user.title: Aurora+ Authentication Method

oauth_authorize.description:
1. Click the link below to open Aurora+ login page
2. Log in with your credentials
3. Complete Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
4. You'll be redirected to an error page - this is normal!
5. Click 'Continue' when ready to proceed

**Authorization URL:** {auth_url}
oauth_authorize.title: Complete Aurora+ Authorization

oauth_complete.description: Copy the complete URL from the error page you were redirected to (it should start with 'https://my.auroraenergy.com.au/login/redirect') and paste it below.
oauth_complete.title: Complete OAuth Setup

manual_token.description: Go to [this page](https://shtrom.github.io/AuroraPlus/), or follow [these instructions](https://github.com/shtrom/AuroraPlus/tree/oauth-mfa-token?tab=readme-ov-file#obtain-a-token) to obtain an access token.
manual_token.title: Manual Access Token
